records.translation: 一个辅助函数服务于所有界面。使用缓存还是下载的判断、按钮的忙碌状态和失败消息，对 Plate Viewer、Tabulate、Graph Builder 及其他界面都是相同的；不同之处只在于填写哪个字段以及由哪个方法打开它。因此界面只需将这一差异作为回调传入，其余都不需要。

records.source: Three public sets have buttons of their own, fetched through the example-set registry (:data:`spacr.example_archives.EXAMPLE_SETS`): ``dose`` (LINCS Cell Painting, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-dose``) for Dose-Response, Prediction Profiler, Run Compare, Run History and Training Runs, ``control_chart`` (CPJUMP1, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-control-chart``) for Control Chart, and ``hit`` (a cut of the TSG101 screen, ``einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit``) for Investigate Hit.
records.translation: 三个公开数据集有各自的按钮，通过示例数据集注册表（:data:`spacr.example_archives.EXAMPLE_SETS`）获取：``dose``（LINCS Cell Painting，``einarolafsson/spacr-example-dose``）用于 Dose-Response、Prediction Profiler、Run Compare、Run History 和 Training Runs；``control_chart``（CPJUMP1，``einarolafsson/spacr-example-control-chart``）用于 Control Chart；``hit``（TSG101 筛选的一个子集，``einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit``）用于 Investigate Hit。

records.context: Read from package data on every call; the folder holds a handful of small files and is only read when Experiment Design builds its menu. A file that does not parse is skipped rather than raised, so one bad template does not remove the others from the menu.

records.source: Read from package data on every call; the folder holds a handful of small files and is only read when Experiment Design builds its menu. A file that does not parse is skipped rather than raised, so one bad template does not remove the others from the menu.
records.translation: 每次调用都从包数据中读取；该文件夹只包含少量小文件，并且只在 Experiment Design 构建其菜单时读取。无法解析的文件会被跳过而不是抛出异常，因此一个有问题的模板不会让其他模板从菜单中消失。
